# Community conduct

Be respectful and constructive. Discuss technical choices with evidence, welcome different experience levels, and respect privacy. Harassment, threats and sharing another person's private information are not accepted. Maintainers may remove abusive content or restrict participation.

Report concerns privately through the contact route in [the security policy](SECURITY.md).
